# Setting up functions

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)

compute_entropy <- function(df){

  df[is.na(df)] <- 0
 
  dem <- df['left']
  rep <- df['right']
  mod <- df['mixed']
  pleft <- (dem+1)/(rep+dem+mod+1)
  pright <- (rep+1)/(rep+dem+mod+1)
  pmod <- (mod+1)/(rep+dem+mod+1) 
  entropy <- ( -1*pleft*log2(pleft) - pright*log2(pright) - pmod*log2(pmod)) 
  df['entropy'] <- entropy
  return(df)
}

# This function allows you to also filter and control for topic level if needed.
prep_data_lp <- function(g, df){
  set.seed(1001)
  cd <- centr_degree(g, mode = ("in"))
  V(g)$'cdi' <- cd$res
  
  topic_cols <- c("topic_level1", "topic_level2", "topic_level3", "topic_level4")
  vertex_matches <- match(V(g)$name, df$subreddit)
  vertex.attributes(g)[topic_cols] <- df[vertex_matches, 4:7]
  
  gdf <- igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = c("both"))
  
  zf <- left_join(gdf$edges, gdf$vertices, by = c("from" = "name")) %>% 
    left_join(.,gdf$vertices, by = c("to" = "name"))

  zf_matches <- zf %>% 
    mutate(is_match = ifelse(lean_e.x==lean_e.y, 1, 0),
           is_matchnm = ifelse(lean_enm.x==lean_enm.y, 1, 0),
           topic1_match = ifelse(topic_level1.x==topic_level1.y, 1, 0),
           topic2_match = ifelse(topic_level2.x==topic_level2.y, 1, 0),
           topic3_match = ifelse(topic_level3.x==topic_level3.y, 1, 0),
           topic4_match = ifelse(topic_level4.x==topic_level4.y, 1, 0)) %>% 
    group_by(from) %>% 
    summarise(matches = sum(is_match),
              matchesnm = sum(is_matchnm),
              t1 = sum(topic1_match),
              t2 = sum(topic2_match),
              t3 = sum(topic3_match),
              t4 = sum(topic4_match),
              cdi.x = sum(cdi.x)/3,
              tot_cdi.y = sum(cdi.y), 
              lean_e.x = unique(lean_e.x)) %>% 
    ungroup(.)
  
  
  zf$seen <- 1
  zfe <- zf %>% dplyr::select(from, lean_e.x, lean_e.y, seen) %>% pivot_wider(names_from=lean_e.y, 
                                                                values_from = seen, 
                                                                values_fill = 0,
                                                                values_fn = sum)

  zf2 <- zf %>% dplyr::select(from, cdi.y) %>% group_by(from) %>% summarize(tot_cdi = sum(cdi.y))
  #zf2 <- zf2 %>% mutate(score_diff = score.x - score.y) %>% group_by(from) %>% summarise(cumu_score = sum(score_diff))

  zf2 <- left_join(zfe, zf2, by=c("from"))
  zf_ent <- compute_entropy(zf2) %>% select(from, entropy)
  
  zf_final <- left_join(zf_matches, zf_ent, by = c("from"))
  return(zf_final)
}
```

# Prepare data

```{r}
dfs <- read.csv("data/subreddit_topic_hierarchy_final.csv")
nets_df_pos <- list()

for (i in 1:6){
   fns <- list.files(paste0("data/stress_test_nets/", i, "_ties"), full.names = TRUE)[3:20]
   
   # Extract the 4-digit year from each file path string
   years <- str_extract(fns, "\\d{4}")
   
   # Read files and assign the years as the list names
   nets <- list()
   nets[[i]] <- setNames(lapply(fns, readRDS), years)
   
   net_df <- lapply(nets[[i]], prep_data_lp, df=dfs)
   nets_df_pos[[i]] <- bind_rows(net_df, .id = "year")
   print(paste0("Done with ", i, " ties"))
}

ndf <- bind_rows(nets_df_pos, .id = "ties")
ndf$year <- as.integer(ndf$year)
ndf$type <- "Positive"
```


# Run the fixed effects model. You can switch network type to determine results for negative nets.

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(plm)
library(tvReg)
library(fixest)

# Filter to negative for negative network.
syrs <- ndf %>% group_by(from) %>% arrange(from, year) %>% filter( n() > 2) %>% 
  mutate(ord = row_number(), ent_year = year[1], trial = 3) %>% filter(ties == 1) 


syrs$mper <- syrs$matches/3
syrs$trial <- 3

# Model bounded strictly between 0 and 3. 
model_bounded <- feglm(mper ~ ord + cdi.x + tot_cdi.y| from, 
                       data = syrs, 
                       family = "quasibinomial",
                       weights = ~trial,
                       vcov = ~from)

# Running model checks, etcetera.
exp(coef(model_bounded))
summary(model_bounded)
```
